title: Weapon Cables
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR COMBAT COMMAND.FA4830  23 CONS CC
detail_text: This is a Sources Sought notice for market research purposes only. The Government is seeking to identify qualified sources, capable of providing the following item: NAICS: 332994 GAU-2 Harness W03 – M134 - RHS, NSN: 5995-01-698-1075 Quantity: 4 Capability questions: Do you manufacture NSN: 5995-01-698-1075? Are you the OEM or an authorized distributor? What is the lead time to provide this product? Firms that respond shall provide clear evidence that they can meet or exceed the specifications. The purpose of this post is to seek sources for market research purposes and no contract or obligation from the government will come of it. Please submit all information to ashley.castillo_flynn@us.af.mil. If you have any questions, you may email or call (229)-257-4717.
